label: GO step after an unrewarded visit to S1 (earlier in the episode)
explanation: Fires only at GO steps (100% of mass) and almost only when the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward==0 holds 99.9% of mass; never after reward). Within that, it prefers trials where the previous reached state was S1 (unrewarded S1 = evidence that S2 is good): GO & prev_reward==0 & prev_state==1 gives dev F1 0.40, mass recall 0.82. It is strongly modulated by episode time: rate is highest in the first ~10 trials and decays to near zero by trials 90-99, so adding ep_trial<60 raises dev F1 to 0.49 (precision 0.37, recall 0.70). Activations go with the policy choosing a2 (model_act==2 holds 87% of mass) and with mid-range value (7.54-7.73 bin holds 65% of mass), but adding these as conditions did not raise F1. No firing at D1 or D2, or after rewarded trials. Precision stays low: many GO steps after unrewarded S1 visits stay silent, especially late in the episode, so the feature probably encodes a graded signal of no reward at S1, push toward a2, that weakens as the agent becomes more certain. Uses only observed variables.
